scope_decision: User-agreed focus: democratizing access to geophysical processing and inversion through QGIS; implementation decisions delegated to the maintainer agent on 2026-11-06.
title: TerraWorkbench: Democratizing access to geophysical processing and inversion through QGIS
study_role: Prospective reproducibility replay of previously explored public datasets. This is not a new blind confirmatory study, externally preregistered trial, geological discovery, or human usability experiment.

primary_acceptance.rule: All six named processing cases must pass their frozen implementation-defined numerical and integrity gates. Every attempted case, including failures and setup errors, is retained.
primary_acceptance.threshold_origin: Tolerances are inherited from the archived development campaign, not newly invented or fitted after this replay. Exact tolerances, parameters, masks and reference choices are in the frozen runner source.
primary_acceptance.geometry_units_masks: Reference shape and finite support must match. Error units follow each returned physical component. No universal percent-error threshold.
primary_acceptance.interpretation: Execution/numerical reference agreement only; no general calibration or geological recovery assertion.

secondary_inversion.data_origin: SimPEG tutorial simulated examples; no true-model arrays in pinned downloads
secondary_inversion.sigma: 0.02 times maximum absolute observed anomaly, matching the archived executable recipe, not measured instrument uncertainty
secondary_inversion.split: Every fifth file-order station withheld; known historical split, not independent spatial-block validation
secondary_inversion.threshold_origin: Legacy engineering regression gates from the 2026-11-05 campaign, not universal scientific acceptance thresholds.
secondary_inversion.interpretation: Numerical prediction replay and Choclo/Geoana forward cross-check; common framework and physics remain shared. No geological recovery claim.

percent_metrics.nrmse_std_percent: 100 * RMSE / population standard deviation of observed target on the explicitly named evaluation set
percent_metrics.degenerate_scale: Undefined when target standard deviation is zero; report null and reason.
percent_metrics.reference_comparison: Reference-solver disagreement must not be described as field-data misfit.
percent_metrics.model_error: Only meaningful against a known truth model or explicitly declared external reference; field prediction RMSE is not model recovery.
percent_metrics.gate: NRMSE is descriptive, not an automatic pass threshold or percentage geological accuracy.

reproducibility.frozen_sources: LF-normalized SHA256 of all Core modules, both runners, protocol and data registry before execution
reproducibility.inputs: Existing checksum-pinned caches; no raw-data redistribution
reproducibility.runtime: Record Python, OS and installed library versions. Native numerical libraries and hardware are not guaranteed bitwise-identical.
reproducibility.timings: Observed wall times only, no controlled performance superiority claim.

amendments: Never overwrite freeze-v1.json. Any source, split, parameter or acceptance change requires a new protocol version, parent-freeze hash, reason and fresh run. Retain unsuccessful and superseded runs.
excluded_claims: Human productivity or accessibility improvement without a user study
Independent blind validation on datasets already used for tuning
publication_pending: Confirm author list, affiliations, funding and AI-use disclosure
Confirm exact Canadian processed-export publication rights before paper figures/data release
Resolve spectral dataset licence if added beyond historical evidence
Choose journal and archive a release with DOI; no submission or email is authorized by this protocol
